answer_1.quote: Dialogue summarization, a recently popular subfield of text summarization, has more challenging factual issues involved.
answer_1.outputs: summaries generated by four common models on two dialogue summarization datasets

answer_2.quote: We select four commonly used factuality metrics: FactCC, DAE, QuestEval, and BARTScore.

answer_4.quote: We recruited college students as annotators. Annotators are required to be able to read and understand English daily conversations and articles fluently and have good English writing skills.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators will determine whether the summary is factually correct first. If there are factual errors, they will mark the inconsistent spans, assign an error category, and write a corrected summary following the principles: correct with as few modifications as possible, prefer substitution, and ensure grammatical correctness, coherence, and non-redundancy.
